accueil.titre: Maryse's cooking notebook, open to the whole family
accueil.intro: Tried-and-tested recipes, the week's menu on the fridge and a shopping list that writes itself. Just like Maryse's notebook, but in your pocket.
accueil.photoNote: The day I got my medal. My colleagues told me: “Your notebook, turn it into an app!”
accueil.recettesTexte: Your notebook starts with 20 of Maryse's recipes. Copy the ones you like, add your own, find them by how much time you have.
accueil.planningTexte: Lunch and dinner, Monday to Sunday: drop a recipe onto a meal, like pinning a note on the fridge.
accueil.coursesTexte: One click and the week's ingredients are gathered, quantities added up. At the shop, you tick them off as you go.
accueil.citation: “I was never a great cook. I was just organised, and that makes all the difference.”
accueil.finTexte: Create your account in a minute: Maryse's recipes are already inside.

histoire.intro: Maryse & Co was born from a squared school notebook, twenty years of dinners to cook and a medal ceremony.
histoire.fiction: A story inspired by Maryse, partly imagined for this demo.

etapes.texte: Maryse leaves early, comes home late, and every evening the same question waits for her at the door: “What's for dinner?”

To stop improvising, she writes everything down in a school notebook: the recipes that work, the week's menu on the back, the shopping list on the last page. The pages get stained, and the notebook never leaves the kitchen.
When Maryse receives her Medal of Honour for Labour, her colleagues give her flowers and some advice: that notebook everyone keeps borrowing should be shared.
The notebook becomes an online notebook. Same recipes, same organisation, and room for every family's own.

histoire.fin: And you, what will you write in your notebook?

fonctionnalites.intro: Three pages to start with, and room for more.

sections.texte: Maryse & Co is a technical demo project with no commercial activity, published from the GitHub repository ClementTro/POCMARYSE.

The site is hosted by GitHub Pages (GitHub Inc., 88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA). Accounts and notebook data are hosted by Supabase Inc., on servers located in the European Union.
The photographs of Maryse are published with the consent of the people shown. Any reuse is forbidden.
For any question, open an issue on the project's GitHub repository.
Your email address, your first name, your preferences (language, theme) and what you write in the notebook: recipes, meal plan and shopping list.
Only to make your notebook work: signing you in and giving you back your data. No ads, no resale, no audience measurement tools.
Nobody but you. Data is protected row by row in the database: an account can only read its own information.
At Supabase, in the European Union. Your language and theme are also remembered in your browser (local storage), with no advertising cookies.
As long as your account exists. Since this site is a demo, inactive accounts may be deleted.
You can ask to access, correct or delete your data by opening an issue on the project's GitHub repository. You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority.
